title: GLOF prioritisation and hydrodynamic simulation in Gilgit-Baltistan and Chitral, northern Pakistan: a reproducible open-data workflow
description: A reproducible workflow with R and Google Earth Engine scripts for lake delineation, corridor extraction, multi-criteria priority scoring, and hydrodynamic hazard analysis. The package encompasses processed spatial datasets and HEC-RAS model inputs for glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) prioritisation across Gilgit-Baltistan and Chitral, northern Pakistan, built entirely on publicly available datasets. Released under the MIT License (see LICENSE).
